canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Belar Corin: 28-year-old woman, 179 cm (tall), ordinary lean-to-average construction without visible definition, skin value band-5-medium-deep. Face: soft rectangular face; large hooded eyes and a broken brow line; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: dark-brown, asymmetric-extreme, deliberate accent: sculptural diagonal fringe. Wardrobe: draped-robe, specifically a draped robe whose belting and openings keep the body construction legible; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette oxblood-navy. Visible personal details: no accessory and no tattoo. Make stitching, quilting, embroidery, or woven pattern the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: low-maintenance grooming with highly polished footwear. Color treatment: balances one confident color field against quiet neutrals. Pose cue: feet plant evenly while fingertips touch a small personal keepsake. Include a clay tea token only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
